meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器,完成点击、填表、截图与页面检查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要让程序替你在真实网站上点击、填表或采集数据。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser to click, fill forms, and capture screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need a program to click, fill forms, or scrape real websites.

howto.what: Claude 会通过 omowright 驱动一个真实浏览器:在你已登录的站点上导航、填表、点击、截图,也能读 JS 渲染出来的页面;遇到登录、验证码或 OTP 时把控制权交回给你。
howto.when: 当任务需要在浏览器里实际交互时触发:你已登录的站点、填表与点击、JS 渲染页面等;单纯的搜索或未被拦截的静态抓取不走它。

say.text: 打开我已登录的那个后台页面,截个图给我看
say.note: 用你自己的浏览器,不用重新登录

say.text: 帮我把这个网页表单填好并提交
say.note: 先读页面再逐项填,提交前会确认

say.text: 这里要输验证码,交给我手动处理
say.note: 它会暂停,你处理完再继续

howto.what_en: Claude drives a real browser through omowright: navigate, fill forms, click, screenshot sites you are already signed into, and read JS-rendered pages. Logins, CAPTCHAs and OTPs are handed back to you.
howto.when_en: Triggers on interactive browser tasks: signed-in sites, form filling and clicks, JS-rendered pages, and more. Not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Open that dashboard I'm signed into and screenshot it for me
say_en.note: Uses your own browser; no re-login

say_en.text: Fill in this web form and submit it
say_en.note: Reads the page, fills fields, confirms first

say_en.text: There's a CAPTCHA here - hand it over to me
say_en.note: Claude pauses, you solve it, then it continues
